Welcome to JUNIOR ENGINEER HK ⚡
I'm HUMENDRA KUMAR

Agar aap Electrical Engineering ko easy Hinglish mein practical examples aur industrial knowledge ke saath seekhna chahte hain, to aap sahi channel par h. Yahan Mechanical, Machines, Science aur Technology bhi simply explain kiye jate h.

📚 Yahan aap seekhenge:
✅ Electrical Wiring, Motors & Motor Control
✅ VFD, PLC & Industrial Automation
✅ Transformer & Electrical Machines
✅ Industrial Electrical & Troubleshooting
✅ Mechanical Machines & Technology
✅ Industrial Machinery
✅ Science & Engineering Facts
✅ Everyday Things & How They Work
✅ Transportation & Technology
✅ Safety Systems & Safety
✅ interesting fact
🎯 Mera Mission: Engineers, Electricians, Technicians aur Students ko practical knowledge dena jo job, industry aur real life mein useful ho.

🔔 Subscribe to JUNIOR ENGINEER HK for easy explanations & videos.
